text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki won the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, achieving Japan's
long-cherished dream. The next day, when I went to her room
to call her...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Step, step—)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: âAh, Trainer-san!
choice_data_list: It's about time for lunch, but...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh, already!?
I was just about to start inking—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (Grrrrrr...)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah... um, I've been working non-stop
ever since breakfast, so... hehe.
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself too hard, alright?
Don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That may be true, but... ever since yesterday, ideas have just been pouring out of me nonstop!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That sight... was sheer, unadulterated frenzy.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The moment my story transcended the world...
...I just have to draw this!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The deafening cheers, the racing heartbeat...
I have to sketch this down while the memory is still fresh!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So, could you please give me just a little more time?
Just te... no, 30 more minutes!
choice_data_list: Saying that will make this take forever! Cut it off here~
Saying that will make this take forever, right? Cut it off here~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While stopping her, I feel a sense of relief. Even after a historic victory, she's still throwing herself wholeheartedly into stories, just as she always has.
choice_data_list: Even if you conquer the world, you haven't changed, huh.
Even if you conquer the world, you haven't changed, have you?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Pardon?
choice_data_list: Because I thought you might've had a change of heart or something.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Not much of a noticeable change, really...?
Besides—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's only gonna get more exciting from here!
My races... my story, that is!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just think about it!
What everyone will be thinking for my next race is—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "What kind of run will Kiseki, the winner of that Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, show us today!?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—"What kind of excitement will it bring?"
That's right, a new chapter has already begun!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
When a new chapter begins, reader expectations are on a whole different level!
The excitement builds higher and higher, until one day—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It's gonna be the most interesting story ever!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"The stage and the characters will evolve even further...
reaching a brilliance never before seen!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —And so, yet another wave of excitement is born. Today's fervor will lead into tomorrow's passion!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow, next year, even 100 years from now.
The story will go on forever—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That would make a great line...
Note that down, note that down!
choice_data_list: ...Come on, let's hurry up and get some food!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The frenzy she ignited leads to the next.
The story connects... seemingly without end.
